verdicts.quote: Allocate available seats to eligible active entries in accepted join order, one booking per member and occurrence. A promotion consumes its seat and ends its entry as one visible outcome.
The queue is ordered by accepted joins per occurrence, including a definite order for simultaneous admissions. No priority tiers or waitlist-size product cap are assumed.

The same member may independently wait for distinct occurrences if allowed by existing eligibility. ... whether a waitlisted member can be booked under existing payment, waiver, credit, schedule conflict and late-cancellation terms.
verdicts.missing: Whether promotion into one of two overlapping classes ends, keeps, or skips the member's other waitlist entry.

verdicts.quote: whether a waitlisted member can be booked under existing payment, waiver, credit, schedule conflict and late-cancellation terms ... No new charges, offer windows, penalties or priority schemes are introduced by this spec.
verdicts.missing: How existing late-cancellation/no-show rules apply to an auto-promoted booking (e.g. a promotion close to class start the member cannot attend).

verdicts.quote: an effective booking cancellation that frees a seat triggers reevaluation by the booking authority with every member view closed.
verdicts.missing: The timeliness of the background promotion; latency is only to be measured and set later by owners.

verdicts.quote: In-app confirmation on read is the default. Background push, email, and SMS have no delivery commitment.
If several seats are available, process up to capacity or until the queue is exhausted. ... A stale signal cannot reopen a closed waitlist, exceed capacity, or assign two bookings for one entry.

Active membership and a confirmed booking are mutually exclusive for the same pair. ... Concurrent joins, bookings, withdrawals, cancellations and closure resolve in a single authoritative order for that occurrence.
If existing terms require new permission or an interactive step, the affected join and promotion path is unready pending a product decision. No new charges ... are introduced by this spec.
verdicts.missing: When payment is taken for a promoted booking and what happens if it fails.

verdicts.quote: No priority tiers or waitlist-size product cap are assumed.
Close enrollment and promotion at the earlier of occurrence start or an existing earlier booking cutoff, or on class cancellation.
